$comment: Every top-level key permitted in pnpm-workspace.yaml, with how it was
verified. scripts/check-settings.mjs fails on any key absent from this file.
This exists because pnpm silently ignores unrecognised settings: a fabricated
key such as `totallyFakeSettingXyz: true` sits in the file and reads back
cleanly from `pnpm config get`, so a policy file can advertise controls that
do not exist. That has already happened in this repository in both
directions - a real setting was deleted as fake, and a setting with no
documented - named in the pnpm settings reference; cite the page
observed   - seen to change behaviour in this repository; cite the error
tested     - behaviourally tested in isolation; cite the observation
unverified - neither documented nor demonstrable; MUST NOT be relied on

savePrefix.note: With no setting, `pnpm add is-odd` writes ^3.0.1; with savePrefix "" it writes 3.0.1.

saveExact.note: Independently produces 3.0.1 where the default produces ^3.0.1.

minimumReleaseAge.note: Minutes. Default 1440 from pnpm v11, 0 before.

minimumReleaseAgeStrict.note: Defaults true when minimumReleaseAge is set explicitly.

minimumReleaseAgeIgnoreMissingTime.note: Defaults TRUE, which skips the age gate for packages whose registry metadata lacks a time field. Must be false.

blockExoticSubdeps.note: Already defaults to true; stated explicitly.

verifyDepsBeforeRun.note: Fired ERR_PNPM_VERIFY_DEPS_BEFORE_RUN ('Catalogs cache outdated') and blocked turbo until pnpm install was re-run.

strictDepBuilds.note: Fired ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS on msgpackr-extract and on an empty allowBuilds.

allowBuilds.note: Entries set to false appear in `pnpm config get ignoredBuiltDependencies --json`, and an empty map fails the install.

autoInstallPeers.note: With false, unmet peers surface as ERR_PNPM_PEER_DEP_ISSUES instead of being invented.

strictPeerDependencies.note: Turned the @effect/opentelemetry peer gap into an install failure.

patchedDependencies.note: pnpm patch-commit records the patch hash in the lockfile; changing the setting triggers ERR_PNPM_VERIFY_DEPS_BEFORE_RUN. A frozen install applies the exact Semantic UI patch, and the React 19 Portal tests prove the patched element-ref path.

catalogs.note: Named catalogs. Verified with pnpm pack: a dependency on `catalog:` publishes as the literal version and a peerDependency on `catalog:peers` publishes as the literal range, so the two concerns stay separate without duplicating values across manifests.

unadopted.$comment: Settings seen in the reference that look relevant and have not been assessed.
unadopted.trustPolicy: Supply-chain trust policy; default off. Assess.
unadopted.minimumReleaseAgeExclude: Per-package age-gate exemptions. We deliberately have none; leaving it unset is the stricter choice.
unadopted.ignoredOptionalDependencies: Could exclude msgpackr-extract's native binaries outright rather than only denying its build.
unadopted.packageManagerStrictVersion: REMOVED 2026-08-25. Could not be shown to be a real setting: absent from the pnpm settings reference, zero hits in a code search of pnpm/pnpm, and no behavioural difference across four configurations with it both true and false. No test available can distinguish it from a fabricated key - `pnpm config get` echoes any key in the file, and pnpm exports any key as an npm_config_* env var, including totallyFakeSettingXyz. It was also redundant: pnpm's launcher already honours the packageManager field. Replaced by scripts/check-package-manager.mjs, which asserts the running pnpm equals the pin. Re-adopt only with positive evidence.
